mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate earnings visibility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% over the prior 2 months signal broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 1% and RSAFS falls > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle with high inflation (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), restrictive policy combined with persistent inflation erodes equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals economic deceleration that reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where GDPC1 growth (annualized) is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months) and weak consumer demand (RSAFS growth < 0.3% in 3 months) signals wage-price spiral risks that trigger equity volatility, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth < 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and RSAFS growth is below 0.3% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
